name: CamelEval
description: An evaluation benchmark designed to assess Arabic-English bilingual large language models on culturally aligned tasks, including instruction following, open-ended question answering, and factually accurate information generation about the Arabic region. It addresses limitations of the Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard (OALL).
reputation: A recent niche benchmark for Arabic-English culturally aligned evaluation that is promising but not yet broadly established as a standard leaderboard.
notes: Benchmark focuses on Arabic language and cultural alignment, improving upon existing Arabic LLM evaluation leaderboards.
